title: Rabbi David Tawil: Life Lessons From Pirke Abot- "Greed & Entitlement"

chapters.title: Social experiments on wealth and behavior
Defining empathy and the impact of privilege
Tora laws as a balance to ambition
Practical applications of Bizelem Elohim
chapters.about: Treating others with respect and common courtesy

chapters.title: Money management and parenting challenges
chapters.about: Teaching children the value of money

summary: Rabbi Tawil explores the dangers of greed and entitlement by contrasting the negative qualities of Billaam with the humble and charitable nature of Abraham Abinu. He discusses how modern prosperity can diminish empathy and offers practical strategies for parents to teach children the value of hard work and responsibility.
questions: How does success and privilege affect a person's ability to feel empathy?
What are the three negative qualities associated with Billaam?
How did Abraham Abinu demonstrate the opposite qualities of Billaam?
How can parents teach their children to avoid a sense of entitlement?
Why does the Tora mandate giving Sedaka?
